title: Best Computer Mouse (2026)
summary: The top picks combine ergonomic comfort, high‑performance gaming features, and versatile productivity tools, with multiple sites agreeing on the best choices.
method: Products were selected from Tom's Hardware (0), Tom's Guide (1), PCWorld (2), and RTings (3); those mentioned by more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are shown only when explicitly stated; otherwise they are omitted. No external data was added.

products.name: Logitech MX Master 4
why: The Logitech MX Master 4 is praised for its comfortable right‑handed shape, dual‑scroll wheel and robust software suite, making it ideal for long work sessions and creative tasks.
Both Tom's Guide and RTings highlight its ergonomic design, long battery life and functional gesture controls, positioning it as the top office‑productivity mouse.
products.best_for: Office workers, designers and anyone needing comfort for extended use
products.amazon_listing: Logitech MX Master 4 Ergonomic Wireless Mouse with Haptics - Graphite | Advanced performan

products.name: Razer Cobra Pro
why: Razer’s Cobra Pro earns top marks for its Razer Focus Pro 30K sensor, dedicated DPI up/down buttons and full‑range RGB lighting across 11 zones.
PCWorld notes its excellent performance but mentions the extra cost of the Hyper polling dongle and a slightly heavier feel for large‑hand users.
pros: Easy DPI switching on the fly
cons: Hyper polling dongle adds extra cost
A bit heavier than the DeathAdder V3 Pro
products.best_for: Competitive gamers who want high precision and customizable lighting
products.skip_if: You have very large hands or a tight budget
products.amazon_listing: Razer Cobra Pro Wireless Gaming Mouse, 2.4 Ghz, 170 Hr Battery, Black | 30K Optical Sensor

products.name: Razer Naga V3 Pro
why: Razer’s Naga V3 Pro retains the familiar MMO form factor while adding more buttons, an upgraded sensor and switches, and improved battery life.
Tom's Hardware highlights these upgrades as making it a strong choice for both MMO gamers and productivity power users.
cons: May be overkill for non‑MMO users
products.skip_if: You don’t need many programmable buttons

products.name: Logitech Pro X2 SuperStrike
why: The Logitech Pro X2 SuperStrike stands out as the best gaming mouse because of its unique haptic clicks, impeccable build quality, and comfortable shape.
It offers a high polling rate and low click latency, making it ideal for competitive shooters.
products.skip_if: You have a very small hand or a modest budget
